equations.title: flat three-point lift
equations.assumptions: Actual E8 residues; h=1/34. Flat permutation-equivariant descent gives a linear B3 representation.

equations.title: tensor exchange parities
equations.assumptions: Channel order1,248,3875,30380,27000; actual invariant tensor permutations, not arbitrary square-root choices.

equations.title: based half-braid reconstruction
equations.equation: R1=sum_i mu_i P_i(U); R2=X R1 X
equations.assumptions: Simple pure spectrum; positive counterclockwise exchanges at ordered base(0,1/2,1); canonical local logarithms.

equations.title: exact half-braid spectrum
equations.assumptions: zeta=exp(2pi i/17); squared spectrum agrees with existing U,V channel by channel.

equations.title: linear braid and squares
equations.assumptions: Exact flat equivariant KZ descent; exact cyclotomic braid model and rigorous same-chart consistency replay. Residual enclosure alone is not an equality proof.

equations.title: central full twist
equations.assumptions: Central rotation integrates h(A+B+C); independently verified in the Tuba-Wenzl model overQ(zeta17).

equations.title: half-braid orders and determinants
equations.assumptions: Displayed five distinct signed half phases, with the tensor-permutation lift fixed.

equations.title: Tuba-Wenzl class
equations.assumptions: Five-dimensional simple B3 module; all20 Proposition2.8 polynomials are nonzero; uniqueness is Theorem2.9.

equations.title: cyclotomic integral realization
equations.equation: rho(B3) is conjugate to a subgroup of GL5(Z[zeta17])
equations.assumptions: Retained ordered triangular matrices have integral cyclotomic coefficients and unit determinant; exact chart conjugator is not computed.

equations.title: linear modular normalization
equations.equation: Ti=zeta^5 Ri; (T1 T2)^3=(T1 T2 T1)^2=I; det Ti=1
equations.assumptions: Common character twist changes pure squares tozeta^10U,zeta^10V; original normalization is kept distinct.

equations.title: triangle-group quotient
equations.equation: normalized image is a quotient of Delta(2,3,34)
equations.assumptions: s=T1T2T1,t=T1T2; s^2=t^3=(t^-1s)^34=1. Faithfulness and the full normal kernel remain open.

equations.title: pure-loop spectral recovery from half-braids
equations.assumptions: Exact field arithmetic in the independent algebraic model; identification with analytic operators is up to simultaneous conjugacy, using KZ descent and classification.
